title: The three Lists dialogs place their buttons three different ways
where: New list dialog (/admin/lists), Edit list and Add numbers dialogs (/admin/lists/[id]), 1440px
what_happens: New list: grey footer bar, Cancel + Create list on the right. Edit list: Save on the left, no Cancel, no footer, trash on the right. Add numbers: 'Add to list' on the left inside the body, no footer. Archive session also uses the footer with Cancel on the right.
who_hurts: An admin has to look for the main button in a different corner in each dialog; small, but it makes the three feel built separately.
suggested_fix: Use DialogFooter for Edit list and Add numbers like create-list-form.tsx and archive-toggle.tsx: main button on the right. For Edit, keep the trash icon on the left of the footer, set apart from Save.
rule: Established pattern: create-list-form.tsx and sessions/[code]/archive-toggle.tsx use DialogFooter with Cancel + main action on the right.
